TagsByText.absentHint: The work has not this tag at all: answered on the work as absent, every paragraph of the tag offered no more; the model of the closeness learns nothing from it
TagsByText.enoughNotHint: The paragraph is about this tag, but that is not enough for the work to have it: this pair is offered no more, and the model learns nothing from it
TagsByText.ignoreHint: The tag is ignored altogether: offered nowhere, read by no model; taken back on the tag's page
TagsByText.loading: Comparing the paragraphs with the tags…
TagsByText.none: No chapters with text: nothing to compare with
TagsByText.notFitted: Ordered by closeness; chances appear once you have answered "yes" and "wrong"
TagsByText.pending: The chapters' paragraphs are still being encoded: the list comes once they are
TagsByText.title: Tags by the text of the work
TagsByText.toggleHint: The tags the paragraphs of this work's chapters are closest to, each with its paragraph
TagsByText.wrongHint: The text and the tag are about different things: the model learns from it
TagsByText.yesHint: The work has this tag by this paragraph: the tag is marked on the work
